subject: Concordia Health renewal - request for safety-net concessions and SLA add-on
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@concordiahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@concordiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Concordia renewal - request for safety-net concessions and SLA add-on

Hi Logan / Redwood team,

Thanks for the conversation last week. We’re at an internal milestone where the board wants stronger operational protections and predictable TCO for year one before we sign a 24-month renewal. Two items are blocking final approval:

1) A safety-net commercial concession (to offset risk of model migration work) — we're targeting ~20% off year1 list or an equivalent one-time credit.
2) An SLA addendum guaranteeing higher uptime and faster incident response (99.9% with 4-hr P1 response) and a limited trial of expanded support hours for the first 6 months.

Attached is a short workbook with usage projections and an annotated SLA request. We’re trying to get this over the line by next week (June 3). Can Redwood propose an authorization path and who on your side I should expect to hear from for executive approval?

Thanks — appreciate your help.

Emily Zhou
Director, Cloud Procurement
Concordia Health
Attachments: Concordia_Renewal_MAPlist.xlsx, Concordia_SLA_Addendum_draft.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@concordiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concordia renewal - request for safety-net concessions and SLA add-on

Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the workbook. I’ve looped in Marissa (your AM) and Vivek (Director, Deal Desk) and Kimberly (Legal) so we can coordinate quickly.

Quick notes: we can absolutely review a one-time credit or term-structured discount and we have an SLA addendum template Marissa can propose. Any commercial concession like 20% off year-one list will need an exec-level signoff — I’ll route formally if Marissa and Vivek recommend it.

Marissa / Vivek — can you review Emily’s workbook and propose a save package (pricing + SLA language) that balances retention economics with Concordia’s board ask? If there’s a material P&L impact we’ll need an approval note for the revenue committee.

Emily — we’ll aim to get a recommendation to you by EOD Friday (May 28). If you have a hard board deadline earlier, tell me now and I’ll prioritize.

Best,

Logan Wright
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Concordia renewal - request for safety-net concessions and SLA add-on

Team — I reviewed Emily’s workbook and talked to GTM / pricing. Proposed save package we can recommend to Concordia:

- Commercial: 20% off year-one list OR a $125,000 one-time credit (we should offer the credit to protect gross margin depending on how they want to recognize).
- Term: reset to 12 months for the renewal term (Concordia specifically asked to avoid multi-year lock while they run migration proof points).
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime target, 4-hour P1 response, expanded support hours (6a-10p PT) for the first 6 months as a trial.
- Conditions: standard usage floors preserved; any overage billed at list. Offer conditioned on signature by June 7.

Attachments: draft SLA addendum (Concordia_SLA_Addendum_draft.pdf) and annotated MAP. I’ve redlined language to limit financial exposure on credits and to add an automatic review at 6 months.

I think this is a borderline-but-workable save: upfront credit is costly but preserves ARR recognition. If we need to preserve more margin, we can convert to a smaller discount + performance milestones.

Marissa
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concordia renewal - request for safety-net concessions and SLA add-on

Folks — reviewed Marissa’s recommendation. Financial impact estimate: if they take the 20% year-one discount we’re looking at ~USD 180k gross revenue reduction in year one relative to baseline (assuming MAP consumption in workbook). $125k credit is slightly better for margins but still material.

Given Concordia’s strategic profile (medium-sized, high-reference value in healthcare) and their migration risk, I’m supportive of providing a concession, but this is an executive-decision:

- Approve the $125k one-time credit + SLA addendum trial for 6 months; OR
- Approve a mitigated offer: 15% year-one discount + $30k implementation credit + SLA trial.

Requesting Logan to authorize which path we present to customer (option A or B). If Logan signs option A we’ll prepare an approval memo for Revenue Committee and route for sign-off. If option B we can approve within Deal Desk.

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@concordiahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@concordiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concordia renewal - request for safety-net concessions and SLA add-on

Emily — appreciate the patience. We ran scenarios with pricing and legal and want to offer a path that helps Concordia’s board while respecting Redwood’s economics. Final commercial proposal (we can finalize in DocuSign once you confirm):

Option A (requires exec approval):
- $125,000 one-time credit applied at signature
- 12-month term reset
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime target; 4-hour P1 response SLA; expanded support hours (6a-10p PT) for first 6 months trial

Option B (Deal Desk approval, faster turnaround):
- 15% off year-one list + $30,000 implementation credit
- 12-month term reset
- SLA addendum as above (6-month trial)

We strongly prefer Option B for speed and to reduce approval friction. If Concordia needs the full $125k credit we will route Option A to our Revenue Committee — that will add 48–72 hours for exec review. Please let us know which option you prefer by EOD Wednesday (June 2) and I’ll circulate the appropriate approval packet or DocuSign envelope.

Logistics: DocuSign (Draft): https://docusign.example/envelopes/0b3a9d
Internal hubspot record: https://hubspot.example/contacts/12345

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

Logan Wright
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
